title: UnderWorldSettings
description: Configuration for running the UnderworldGodot project.

pathuw1.description: Folder location of the Underworld 1 game files.

pathuw2.description: Folder location of the Underworld 2 game files.

gametoload.description: Which of the two games to load.

level.description: The game level to load. (0-8 in UW1, 0-71 in UW2)

lightlevel.description: Set the lighting level of the dungeon. Value is ignored.

shader.description: Default shader used. Value is ignored. (was previously used to allow for selection of different shaders during experimentation of palette effects)

showcolliders.description: Enables displaying of collision meshes and colliders in game

shaderbandsize.description: Controls how many light shades are calculated in between the vanilla shades.dat colour palette values to smooth light shading. (no of interpolated colours between the vanilla colours)

vr.description: When true, start in OpenXR VR mode with head tracking and thumbstick movement.

vr_boot_mode.description: VR boot path. explore = load straight into a level; full = intro cutscene, main menu, and character creation on a VR menu screen.

datafolder.description: Save slot used when vr_boot_mode is explore (DATA or SAVE1..SAVE4).

vr_menu_screen_width.description: Width of the front-menu TV quad in metres (vr_boot_mode full).

vr_menu_screen_distance.description: Distance from the headset to the menu TV quad in metres (vr_boot_mode full).

vr_menu_screen_offset_y.description: Vertical offset of the menu TV in metres; negative lowers the screen.

vr_message_scroll_offset_x.description: Head-locked message scroll offset in metres (X right, Y up).

vr_message_scroll_offset_y.description: Head-locked message scroll vertical offset in metres; negative lowers.

vr_status_panels_always_visible.description: When true, head overlays (scroll, flask, gem, eyes) stay visible instead of appearing on events and fading out.

vr_status_panels_display_seconds.description: Seconds to show head overlays after activity before fading (when not always visible).

vr_status_panels_fade_seconds.description: Seconds for head overlay fade-out (when not always visible).

vr_status_screen_width.description: Virtual HUD screen width in metres for head-locked overlays (scroll, flask, gem, eyes).

vr_status_screen_distance.description: Distance in front of the headset for head-locked overlays.

vr_status_panels_offset_y.description: Vertical offset applied to all head overlays in metres; negative lowers the whole group.

vr_health_flask_offset_x.description: Head-locked health flask offset in metres (X right, Y up).

vr_health_flask_offset_y.description: Head-locked health flask vertical offset in metres; negative lowers.

vr_power_gem_offset_x.description: Head-locked attack power gem offset in metres (X right, Y up).

vr_power_gem_offset_y.description: Head-locked attack power gem vertical offset in metres; negative lowers.

vr_eyes_offset_x.description: Head-locked gargoyle/eyes offset in metres (X right, Y up).

vr_eyes_offset_y.description: Head-locked gargoyle/eyes vertical offset in metres; negative lowers.

synth.description: Music synthesizer engine. 'cm32l' and 'mt32' use mt32emu (require ROM files). 'soundfont' uses a SoundFont (SF2) file. 'opl' uses AdLib/OPL FM synthesis.

synthpath.description: Path to ROM directory (for cm32l/mt32) or .sf2 file (for soundfont). Empty = use defaults.

rompath.description: DEPRECATED: use 'synthpath'. Legacy path to ROM directory — still read if synthpath is empty.
